title: "EV"
author: "Mohit Karangutkar"
format: html

---

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ev_data <- read_csv("EV Warranty US.csv", show_col_types=FALSE)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
summary(ev_data)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Convert miles and battery retention into numeric
ev_data$miles <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", ev_data$miles))
ev_data$battery_retention <- as.numeric(gsub("%", "", ev_data$battery_retention))/100

# Remove rows with null miles and battery retention values
ev_data_m <- ev_data[!is.na(ev_data$miles),]
ev_data_br <- ev_data[!is.na(ev_data$battery_retention),]
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_m, aes(ev_year, miles, size=0.01, alpha=0.5)) +
  geom_point(aes(color=OEM)) +
  facet_wrap(~OEM) +
  labs(title="Battery warranty mileage over time",
       x="Time period (years)", y="Battery warranty mileage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
tesla_data <- ev_data_m[ev_data_m$OEM=="Tesla",]
ggplot(tesla_data, aes(ev_year, miles, color=battery_chemistry,
                       alpha=0.5, size=0.1)) +
  geom_jitter(height=0, width=0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(2012, 2025, by=1)) +
  labs(title="Tesla battery warranty mileage",
       x="Time period (years)", y="Battery warranty mileage") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
rivian_data <- ev_data_m[ev_data_m$OEM=="Rivian",]
ggplot(rivian_data, aes(ev_year, miles, color=battery_chemistry,
                       alpha=0.5, size=0.05)) +
  geom_jitter(height=0, width=0.05) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(2021, 2025, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(120000, 180000, by=10000)) +
  labs(title="Rivian battery warranty mileage",
       x="Time period (years)", y="Battery warranty mileage") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data, aes(battery_chemistry, OEM, color=battery_chemistry,
                    size=0.1)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title="Battery chemistry for each manufacturer",
       x="Battery chemistry", y="EV Manufacturer") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_br, aes(OEM, battery_retention,size=0.1,
                       color=battery_chemistry, alpha=0.5)) +
  geom_jitter(height=0, width=0.25) +
  labs(title="Battery retention for each manufacturer",
       x="EV Manufacturer", y="Battery retention") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_m, aes(OEM, years, alpha=0.7, size=0.5, color=years)) +
  geom_jitter(height=0, width=0.2) +
  labs(title="Battery warranty years for each manufacturer",
       x="EV Manufacturer", y="Battery warranty years") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_m, aes(OEM, miles, color=OEM, fill=OEM)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(60000, 180000, by=10000)) +
  labs(title="Battery warranty mileage distribution",
       x="EV Manufacturer", y="Battery warranty mileage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_br, aes(x=battery_chemistry, y=battery_retention, 
                       color=battery_chemistry, size=0.1, alpha=0.5)) +
  geom_jitter(height=0, width=0.1) +
  labs(title="Battery chemistry vs. Battery retention",
       x="Battery chemistry", y="Battery retention") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_br, aes(battery_chemistry, fill=battery_chemistry)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~OEM, scale="free_y") +
  labs(title="EV Count by battery chemistry",
       x="Battery chemistry", y=NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data, aes(OEM, ev_year, fill=OEM)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(2010, 2025, by=1)) +
  labs(title="Time period for each EV in US",
       x="EV Manufacturer", y="Time period (years)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
ggplot(ev_data_m, aes(x=ev_year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y=total_capacity, color="total_capacity")) +
  geom_line(aes(y=usable_capacity, color="usable_capacity")) +
  facet_wrap(~OEM) +
  labs(title="Battery capacity of each manufacturers",
       x="Time period (years)", y="Battery capacity (kWh)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))
```
